name: HUD Kit
summary: A stat panel, boss bars, a message line and a pause overlay, in screen space with real text.
description: Builds a HUD out of the shared UI globals: a titled panel of labelled bars that read themselves from your player script, a message line that fades, and a pause/game-over overlay with buttons. Screen-anchored, so it is correct at any window size and on a phone, and it uses real text rather than the coloured rectangles a prototype used to be stuck with.
nextSteps: Put Hud.js on an empty actor and tag it Hud.
List your bars in `bars`: each needs a label, a colour and the name of a 0..1 getter on the player's script.
Call say("...") on it for the message line, and setPaused(true) for the overlay.
For a boss bar, add a `trackers` entry naming the boss's TAG -- the bar lives exactly as long as the actor does.
